use_case_summary: Helix needs a scalable semantic product search + reranking solution for a large multi-tenant catalog (~12M SKUs). Primary goals are lowering cost per query and ensuring predictable behavior during seasonal traffic spikes (Black Friday). They plan to run a 2-week POC to validate latency, cost, and index sizing; evaluating Redwood's hosted API and Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable burst handling.
requirements_summary: Indexing scale: 12M SKUs, frequent updates (hourly changes for price/availability).
Query volume: baseline 3k QPS worldwide; peak planned 25k QPS for Black Friday window via burst capacity.
Latency targets: p95 search < 250ms; rerank end-to-end < 450ms.
Cost targets: avg cost/query <= $0.001, predictable billing model during spikes.
Model preferences: high-quality embeddings (open models acceptable), ability to fallback to smaller quantized models for cost spikes.
Routing/fallback: multi-region routing with failover to cheaper model variant and degraded relevance instead of outage.
Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, EU data residency.
technical_constraints: Hourly index updates require low-latency incremental re-indexing or upsert API.
Large index (12M vectors) — want guidance on shard sizing, vector compression and hybrid filtering for faceted attributes.
Need SDKs for Java (backend) and Node (edge) with streaming support for rerank pipeline.
POC will use sample 1.2M SKUs and synthetic traffic generator to emulate tail queries.
